title: D CORE LC-LC OM3 3M Multimode Duplex Fiber Patch Cable

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade Your Network's Backbone with High-Performance OM3 Duplex Fiber


The D CORE LC-LC Multimode Duplex Fiber Patch Cord is the essential, high-reliability link for your 10 Gigabit network infrastructure. Engineered for superior performance, this 3-meter (9.8ft) OM3 cable features standard LC duplex connectors on each end, providing a perfect plug-and-play solution for connecting switches, servers, routers, and storage devices in modern data centers and enterprise networks.


Key Features & Benefits:

10Gigabit OM3 Performance: Optimized for 10 Gigabit Ethernet (10GbE) applications at 850nm wavelength with a bandwidth of 2000MHz•km. Also fully compatible with 1Gb/s (Gigabit) and 40/100Gb/s (using MTP breakout) systems.

Precision LC Connectors: The small form-factor LC connectors allow for high port density, saving valuable space in crowded network racks and panels. The duplex design ensures correct polarity for seamless transmit/receive channel alignment.

Ultra Low Insertion Loss: Manufactured with stringent quality control, our patch cords guarantee minimal signal loss (<0.3dB typical), ensuring maximum power budget and network efficiency.

Durable & Reliable Construction: The cable features a flexible, OFNR-rated (Riser) jacket for safe intra-building use. The robust connectors are equipped with a protective pull-proof boot for easy handling and added strain relief.

Standard Aqua Color Coding: The distinctive aqua blue jacket is the industry standard for OM3 multimode fiber, making cable identification and management quick and error-free.

3-Meter Ideal Length: This 9.8-foot length is one of the most popular choices for standard rack-to-rack or intra-cabinet connections, providing flexibility without excess cable clutter.


Technical Specifications:

  • Product Type: Duplex Fiber Patch Cable
  • Connector Type: LC Duplex to LC Duplex
  • Fiber Type: 50/125μm Multimode (OM3)
  • Jacket Color: Aqua
  • Cable Length: 3 Meters (9.8 Feet)
  • Insertion Loss: ≤ 0.3 dB (Typical)
  • Return Loss: ≥ 35 dB (Multimode)
  • Application: Ideal for 10G Ethernet, SANs, NAS, VoIP, and Data Centers.
